paite: Jakeh tapa Agur thute. Huai mi in Ithiel kiang ah, Ithiel leh Ukal kiang ah.
heading: Agur Thute

paite: Chihtaktak in kuamah sang in ka haizaw a, mihing theihsiamna ka nei kei.
Pilna ka sin nai kei a, Mi Siangthou theihna leng aka nei kei, achi hi.

Van ah kua akahtouta in ahong kumsuk a? Akhuttum sung ah kua'n huih alakhawmta a? Apuansilh in kua'n tuite atun a? Lei tawpnate kua'n ahihkipta a? Amin bang ahia? Huan atapa min bang ahia, na theihleh?
Pathian thu chiteng ettel ahi; amah a muangte a ding in lum ahi.
Athute ah behlap ke'n, hon sal dia, zuauthei amuh in na om kha ding hi.
Thil nih ka hon ngen; ka sih ma in huaite hon kitheihmohbawl ke'n.
heading: Thupil Dangte

paite: Bangmah lou leh zuau kei a kipan gamlapi ah suan in. Gentheihna hiam hauhsaknate hiam hon pe ke'n; kei a dia kiphamoh an in hon vak in.
Huchi lou in zaw ka kham in, nang ka hon kitheihmohbawl in, TOUPA kua ahia? Ka chi kha ding hi. Ahihkeileh, ka genthei in, ka gu in, ka Pathian min thanghuaitak in ka bawl kha ding hi.
Apu kiang ah sikha gense ke'n, huchi lou in zaw nang ahon hamsiat dia, mohtansak in na om ding hi.
Apa uh hamsiat suan khat a-om a, anu uh vualzawl lou.
Amau mitte a siangthou suan khat a-om a, ahi a lah anitna ua kipan silsiang louh ahi uhi.
Suan khat a-om a, aw amitte uh sanghah hi na e; huan amitkhu vunte sansak in a-om hi.
Ahate uh namsau bang leh ahate uh temta bang suan khat a-om uh, lei a kipan a migenthei leh tasamte mite lak a kipan anekbeina ding in.
Vot in tanu nih anei a, hon pia in, hon pia in, chi in akikou ua. Thil thum lungkimsak theih ngei louh a-om uh, ahi, li, "Hun e,” chi lou.
Han leh sul hut; lei tui a hihlungkim a om lou; huan mei, "Hun e," chi lou.
Apa nuihsan mit leh anu thuman musit, phaizang va- akte'n atawm ding ua, muvanlai noute'n ane ding uhi.
Thil thum kei a ding a lamdang lua a-om ua, ahi, ka theih louh li.
Huihkhua a muvanlai lampi; suangpi tung a gulpi lampi; tuipi lak a long lampi leh pasal nungak toh alampi.
Huai mah bang in angkawm hat numei lampi ahi; ane a, zapi in akam aka a, gitlouhna ka hih kei, achi hi.
Thil thum ziak in lei aling a, huan thil li apuak zoh louh ziak in;
sikha kumpipa hong hih lai leh mihai ankham lai;
numei huathuaitak in pasal aneih a, sikha nungak in api aluah in.
Leitung ah aneu thil li a-om ua himahleh apil mahmah uh.
Miksite hat lou ganhing hon ahi ua, himahleh nipi lai in anek ding uh asutuah ua;
kawl sazawte hat lou pawltak ahi ua, himahleh suangpi heng ah a-inn abawl uhi.
Khaukhupte'n kumpipa anei kei ua, himahleh ahonhon in avek un kilem in apai uh;
inhikte na khut a na tawi theih ahi ua; himahleh kumpipate inpite ah ateng uh.
Apai chiang ua thupi thil thum a-om ua, ahi, apai chiang ua thupi, li.
Humpinelkai, gamsa laklak a hat penpen, bangmah ma ah akiheimang kei hi;
kidouna sakol; keltal leng; huan kumpipa, amite ma a pai.
Na kiletsak a haitak a na gamtatleh, ahihkeileh ngaihtuahna gilou na neihleh, na kam tung ah na khut koih in,
nawitui pei in nawituidat a- omsak a, nak hek in sisan asuahkhesak; huchi mah bang in thangpaihna paisuak in kilaina a-omsak hi.
